description: IFT-6 / Starship Flight 6 — dense facts from documented flight + BBC live + Musk ocean-landing statement.
pasted_text:
SOURCE NOTES (public flight summary for Newslines pilot).

Date: 2024-11-19. Location: Starbase, Texas (SpaceX).
Mission: sixth integrated flight test of Super Heavy booster and Starship (often called Flight 6 / IFT-6).
Vehicles: Super Heavy Booster 13 and Starship Ship 31.
Goals: operational improvements; heat-shield experiments; steeper reentry angle to gather thermal protection system data.
Payload detail reported: a banana was carried as a payload item.
Launch: successful liftoff and hot-stage separation.
Booster: diverted to a controlled splashdown in the Gulf of Mexico rather than being caught by the tower catch arms ("Mechazilla").
Ship: reignited one Raptor engine in space; flight duration about 1 hour 5 minutes; completed splashdown in the Indian Ocean.
Afterwards (2024-11-20) Musk posts on X about a successful ocean landing of Starship and that SpaceX will do one more ocean landing of the ship; if that goes well, SpaceX will attempt to catch the ship with the tower.

Corroboration URL (BBC live coverage): https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/c87xqd0n1zgt
Musk post: https://twitter.com/elonmusk/status/1859036912348262787
facts: On 19 Nov 2024, SpaceX conducts the sixth integrated flight test of Super Heavy and Starship from Starbase, Texas.
The flight uses Super Heavy Booster 13 and Starship Ship 31.
The test focuses on operational improvements, including heat-shield experiments and flying at a steeper reentry angle to gather thermal-protection-system performance data.
The flight carries a banana as a reported payload item.
Booster 13 is diverted to splashdown in the Gulf of Mexico instead of a catch by the Mechazilla tower arms.
Ship 31 reignites one Raptor engine in space.
After a flight of about 1 hour 5 minutes, Ship 31 completes splashdown in the Indian Ocean.
On 20 Nov 2024, Musk posts that the ocean landing of Starship was successful and that SpaceX will do one more ocean landing of the ship before attempting a tower catch.

subject_quotes.text: Successful ocean landing of Starship! We will do one more ocean landing of the ship. If that goes well, then SpaceX will attempt to catch the ship with the tower.
subject_quotes.speaker: Elon Musk

notes: Short names: Musk, SpaceX, Starship, Super Heavy, Ship 31, Booster 13. Primary action is the flight on Nov 19; Musk post on Nov 20 is part of the same event record as reaction. Prefer BBC link on key verb and X as primary for the quote.
